question.text: Let $M = \begin{bmatrix} a & b &c \\ b &d & e\\ c & e & f \end{bmatrix}$ be a real matrix with eigenvalues $1, 0$ and $3$. If the eigenvectors corresponding to $1$ and $0$ are $\left ( 1,1,1 \right )^T$ and  $\left ( 1,-1, 0 \right )^T$ respectively, then the value of $3f$ is equal to $\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.$
question.subject: Linear Algebra

question.text:
Let $A$ is a diagonal matrix of order $100$ and $d_i$ is diagonal element of $A$. Given that
$$
d_i=\left\{\begin{array}{ll}
2 i+1 ; & \text { if } i \bmod 3=0 \\
i+3 ; & \text { if } i \bmod 3=1 \\
0 ; & \text { if } i \bmod 3=2
\end{array}\right\} \text { where } 1 \leq \mathrm{i} \leq 100
$$
Then what is the value of trace of $A$ ?
question.subject: Linear Algebra
